name: Fibo 2 Edit Turbo ComfyUI
readme:
# Fibo 2 Edit Turbo ComfyUI

Deploy → Connect → Fibo 2 ComfyUI → upload an image → describe an edit → Run.

Use a CUDA 13-compatible GPU with at least 24 GB VRAM and a 60 GB container disk. Runpod supplies the Connect token. Three public model files (17.62 GB) download and verify on first use. Select persistent storage mounted at /workspace to retain models, workflows and images.

The native ComfyUI workflow uses Fibo 2 Edit Turbo INT8, a BF16 Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder and the FLUX.2 VAE, with 4 Euler/simple steps and CFG 1. No external image API key or prompt-enhancer model is required. Your files live in /workspace/ComfyUI.

The baked startup command is /opt/fibo/scripts/entrypoint.sh. The template preserves Runpod SSH and protects the editor with the per-Pod native Connect token.

Fibo weights are CC BY-NC 4.0: noncommercial use only without a separate Bria agreement. Licensing: https://platform.bria.ai/licensing/pricing?model=fibo-2

Source and actual validation status: https://github.com/akhilsivanand/fibo-runpod

Validated on 29 October 2026 with RTX 4090 (24 GB class): real 1024 x 1024 edits in the browser and a fresh queue worker, native Connect authentication, and restart preservation. Dated evidence: https://github.com/akhilsivanand/fibo-runpod/blob/main/docs/validation.json
